new_value: Fixed in 5186bc67. CLAUDE.md's managed block removed with bd setup claude --remove (the documented mechanism; a hand edit inside a hashed block would be regenerated), so the git pull --rebase that AGENTS.md forbids is gone, as are the three profiles and the duplicate load. CLAUDE.md is seven lines pointing at AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md's own generated Beads section carries the guidance and no git policy, so pull --rebase appears once in the repo, in the rule forbidding it. The citations of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.claude/standards/rust.md are dropped: neither exists anywhere under the home directory, so an agent was told about rules it could not read. If global rules are wanted they have to be created and named.
